svg.title: Stored 30-day median retail forecast change, 13 June to 13 September 2026
svg.desc: Three contract terms. All forecasts have low confidence. Lines stop at missing dates and the 27 July model boundary. Dashed horizontal lines mark plus and minus 0.15 c/kWh signal thresholds. The CSV and report give exact values.

g.text: Stored forecasts: expected median price change in 30 days
c/kWh including VAT · Energy only · All rows: low confidence · Not HTML impression history
Gaps: 2–4 Aug and 22 Aug. Above +0.15: lock; below −0.15: wait; between: neutral.
